request.description: Delete a specified recipient belonging to the user. The recipient will continue to exist in the database, but won't be retrievable by the user. The name of the deleted recipient will be available for use in creating a new recipient. All monetary values are represented in minor units, or the smallest unit of the currency with no decimal (e.g., cents). For example, $10.00 is represented as 1000. How can we improve these docs? Share your feedback.
